listing.name: Killzone: Shadow Fall — Killzone Shadow Fall for PC (lesca-191204)
listing.summary: The author reports completing the campaign on a Ryzen 7 5700/RTX 2060 Super PC. AMD graphics and Intel CPUs remain untested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted CUSA00190 folder with eboot and update 01.81, the tested edition. Other regions are listed upstream but are not confirmed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the public beta 0.5.0 runtime ZIP and its launcher to import your own dump.

warnings: The author reports completing the campaign on a Ryzen 7 5700/RTX 2060 Super PC. AMD graphics and Intel CPUs remain untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
